packageRules.description: One PR a week for everything non-breaking. A PR per crate is noise, and each one costs a full CI run.
Actions move together and are low risk; keeping them in one PR keeps the workflow diffs readable.
Majors stay separate — they are the ones that need a changelog read, and the MSRV job is the usual thing they break.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the weekly window and the major-approval gate — waiting until Monday for a known advisory defeats the point.
